facts.claim: The paper trains from scratch a shared early trunk and independently initialized sparse late heads. Individual losses are averaged and jointly update active parameters. No independent-ensemble-first or teacher is required by this printed method.
facts.evidence: §3 architecture/training; AppendixG Algorithm1; resnet_split.py69–105,117–133; main_cifar.py79–105,263–270,296–300; optional resume branch313–317 exists.

facts.claim: Printed topology updates prune and regrow equally many active connections at fixed density using dynamic sparse training, citing RigL/ER; the method may extend sparse training schedules.
facts.evidence: §3 training; Algorithm1 lines19–22. Author sparselearning/core.py and exact mask/growth/moment semantics are not audited.

facts.claim: The joint supervised objective is mean head CE in the inspected CIFAR source, not a new diversity penalty or a member-competence protection rule.
facts.evidence: utils.py125–131 sums individual CE; main_cifar.py88–91 divides by number of heads; loss.backward and one optimizer/mask step follow.

facts.claim: The inspected multihead ResNet has distinct late block/head objects and one trunk forward; this is actual partial parameter untying rather than private diagonal factors around a complete shared model.
facts.evidence: resnet_split.py86–105 separately constructs late blocks and fc per head; forward117–133.

facts.claim: Main text§3 writes mean logits whereas Algorithm1/prose writes mean class probabilities. Pinned CIFAR source returns unnormalized head logits and averages them before CE/argmax.
facts.evidence: §3 inference; AppendixG; resnet_split.py125–133; main_cifar.py184–197. This qualifies the inspected code path only, not all architectures/LM paths.

facts.claim: Bounded §5 discussion reports a nonmonotonic relationship between sharing depth, prediction disagreement and pooled performance. It does not identify an optimum applicable to graphs or prove that shared-gradient conflict caused weak members.
facts.evidence: §§5.1–5.2 selected prose; all figures/table bodies excluded. Numeric illustrative author statements were exposed in prose but are not imported as evidence about current models.
